info.title: CurlShot API
info.description:
Paste a website address and get a screenshot of the whole page as an image or PDF. Free to try, nothing to install. For developers, one simple screenshot API.

Authenticate with an access key: the `access_key` query parameter, the `X-Access-Key` header, or `Authorization: Bearer`. A key can require signed requests: add `signature` (hex HMAC-SHA256 of the sorted query string, keyed with the secret key) and optionally `expires`. Errors are JSON with `error_code`, `error_message` and `documentation_url`; `quota_exceeded` and `feature_not_available` add `upgrade_url`. Human-readable docs: https://curlshot.com/docs. Docs as one markdown file: https://curlshot.com/llms-full.txt.

get.description: Render a URL, HTML or Markdown into a PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF. Exactly one of `url`, `html` or `markdown` is required. A successful render uses one screenshot of the monthly quota; cache hits and failed renders are free.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Address of the page to capture.

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: HTML to render instead of a URL.

parameters.name: markdown
parameters.description: Markdown to render as a styled page instead of a URL.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: File format of the result. mp4, webm and gif record a video of the page.

parameters.name: image_quality
parameters.description: Compression quality for jpeg and webp. From 1 to 100.

parameters.name: image_width
parameters.description: Resize the final image to this width. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: image_height
parameters.description: Resize the final image to this height. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: omit_background
parameters.description: Keep the page background transparent (png and webp).

parameters.name: response_type
parameters.description: Return the file itself, or JSON with a link to it.

parameters.name: viewport_width
parameters.description: Width of the browser window. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: viewport_height
parameters.description: Height of the browser window. A video uses 720 unless you set it. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: device_scale_factor
parameters.description: Pixel density; 2 gives a retina image.

parameters.name: viewport_device
parameters.description: Emulate a phone, tablet or laptop preset.

parameters.name: viewport_mobile
parameters.description: Render the mobile layout (honours the viewport meta tag).

parameters.name: viewport_landscape
parameters.description: Rotate the viewport to landscape.

parameters.name: full_page
parameters.description: Capture the whole page, not just the first screen.

parameters.name: full_page_scroll
parameters.description: Scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded images appear.

parameters.name: full_page_max_height
parameters.description: Cut a full-page capture off at this height. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Capture only the first element matching this CSS selector.

parameters.name: clip_x
parameters.description: Left edge of the area to capture. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: clip_y
parameters.description: Top edge of the area to capture. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: clip_width
parameters.description: Width of the area to capture. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: clip_height
parameters.description: Height of the area to capture. In CSS pixels.

parameters.name: wait_until
parameters.description: Page event that marks the page as loaded.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Extra time to wait after the page has loaded. In seconds.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Give up if the page is not ready after this long. In seconds.

parameters.name: wait_for_selector
parameters.description: Wait until this element is visible before capturing.

parameters.name: dark_mode
parameters.description: Ask the page for its dark theme.

parameters.name: reduced_motion
parameters.description: Ask the page to turn animations off.

parameters.name: media_type
parameters.description: CSS media type to render with.

parameters.name: hide_selectors
parameters.description: Hide every element matching these CSS selectors.

parameters.name: styles
parameters.description: CSS to add to the page.

parameters.name: scripts
parameters.description: JavaScript to run on the page before the capture.

parameters.name: click
parameters.description: Click the first element matching this selector before the capture.

parameters.name: user_agent
parameters.description: User-Agent header the browser sends.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Extra HTTP headers, as "Name: value". In a query string, repeat the parameter once per item.

parameters.name: cookies
parameters.description: Cookies to set, as "name=value; Domain=example.com". In a query string, repeat the parameter once per item.

parameters.name: authorization
parameters.description: Authorization header sent to the target site only.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: IANA time zone the page sees.

parameters.name: block_ads
parameters.description: Block requests to ad networks.

parameters.name: block_trackers
parameters.description: Block analytics and tracking scripts.

parameters.name: block_cookie_banners
parameters.description: Hide cookie consent banners.

parameters.name: block_chats
parameters.description: Block live-chat widgets.

parameters.name: block_resources
parameters.description: Block whole kinds of resources.

parameters.name: block_requests
parameters.description: Block requests whose URL matches these patterns (* is a wildcard).

parameters.name: pdf_paper_format
parameters.description: Paper size of the PDF.

parameters.name: pdf_landscape
parameters.description: Use landscape pages.

parameters.name: pdf_print_background
parameters.description: Print background colors and images.

parameters.name: pdf_margin
parameters.description: Margin on all four sides.

parameters.name: pdf_margin_top
parameters.description: Top margin; overrides pdf_margin.

parameters.name: pdf_margin_right
parameters.description: Right margin; overrides pdf_margin.

parameters.name: pdf_margin_bottom
parameters.description: Bottom margin; overrides pdf_margin.

parameters.name: pdf_margin_left
parameters.description: Left margin; overrides pdf_margin.

parameters.name: pdf_fit_one_page
parameters.description: Put the whole page on a single tall PDF page.

parameters.name: video_duration
parameters.description: Length of the video. Left out, it follows the height of the page. In seconds.

parameters.name: video_max_duration
parameters.description: Longest the video may get when its length follows the page. A taller page then scrolls faster. In seconds.

parameters.name: video_fps
parameters.description: Frames per second. A gif takes at most 15.

parameters.name: video_scroll
parameters.description: Scroll from the top of the page to the bottom while recording.

parameters.name: video_scroll_back
parameters.description: Scroll back to the top at the end, so the video loops cleanly.

parameters.name: video_scroll_easing
parameters.description: How the scroll moves: a soft start and stop, or one even speed.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Serve a stored copy when the same request was made before.

parameters.name: cache_ttl
parameters.description: How long a cached copy stays valid. In seconds.

parameters.name: cache_key
parameters.description: Change this value to force a fresh render.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Return at once and render in the background.

parameters.name: webhook_url
parameters.description: Address that receives the result when the render is done.

parameters.name: webhook_sign
parameters.description: Sign the webhook body so you can verify it came from us.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the query string, for signed links.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds after which the request is refused. Put it in a signed link to give the link a lifetime.

200.description: The rendered file. With `response_type=json` the body is JSON describing the stored file instead.

X-Reference-Id.description: Id of this render. Quote it when you contact support.

X-Quota-Limit.description: Screenshots included in the current billing period.

X-Quota-Remaining.description: Screenshots left: what remains of the plan quota plus any bonus screenshots.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per minute, for the whole account. On status endpoints (usage, jobs, batches, files) it describes their separate, larger allowance.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: When the rate-limit window resets (Unix seconds).

X-Concurrency-Limit.description: Renders this account may run at the same time.

X-Cache.description: HIT when a stored copy was served (not billed), otherwise MISS.

X-Render-Ms.description: Time the render took, in milliseconds.

202.description: Returned when `async=true`: the render was queued.

400.description: `invalid_url`: The URL is not valid. Use a full http:// or https:// address. `invalid_options`: One or more options are not valid. `invalid_request`: The request could not be read. Send a JSON object.

example.error_message: The URL is not valid. Use a full http:// or https:// address.

401.description: `access_key_required`: An access key is required. Pass `access_key` or the `X-Access-Key` header. `access_key_invalid`: The access key is not valid or has been revoked.

example.error_message: An access key is required. Pass `access_key` or the `X-Access-Key` header.

402.description: `quota_exceeded`: The screenshot quota for this billing period is used up.

example.error_message: The screenshot quota for this billing period is used up.

403.description: `host_not_allowed`: This host cannot be rendered. Private, local and internal network addresses are blocked. `signature_required`: This access key only accepts signed requests. Add a `signature` parameter. `signature_invalid`: The request signature does not match. `email_not_verified`: The email address of this account is not verified yet. Open the verification link we emailed you, then retry. `feature_not_available`: Your plan does not include this feature. `request_expired`: This request has expired: its `expires` time is in the past. Create a new link with a later `expires`.

example.error_message: This host cannot be rendered. Private, local and internal network addresses are blocked.

example.error_message: The request or the rendered output is larger than the allowed size.

example.error_message: No element on the page matches the selector.

429.description: `concurrency_limit`: Too many renders are running at once for this account. Retry in a moment. `rate_limited`: Too many requests. Slow down and retry after the indicated delay. `queue_limit`: Too many async jobs of this account are waiting to render. Wait for some to finish, then retry. `failure_limit`: Too many renders of this account failed in the last minute. Fix the failing requests, then retry after the indicated delay.

example.error_message: Too many renders are running at once for this account. Retry in a moment.

example.error_message: Something went wrong while rendering. The render was not billed; please retry.

502.description: `navigation_failed`: The page could not be loaded. Check that the address is correct and publicly reachable.

example.error_message: The page could not be loaded. Check that the address is correct and publicly reachable.

503.description: `renderer_busy`: All render slots are busy right now. Retry in a moment. `renderer_unavailable`: The rendering service is temporarily unavailable. Retry in a moment. `service_unavailable`: The service is temporarily unavailable. Retry in a moment.

example.error_message: All render slots are busy right now. Retry in a moment.

504.description: `timeout`: The page took too long to render. Try a larger `timeout` or a lighter `wait_until`.

example.error_message: The page took too long to render. Try a larger `timeout` or a lighter `wait_until`.

post.summary: Sent to `webhook_url` when a background job ends
post.description: The body is the job exactly as `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}` returns it, plus `event`. Signed with two headers: `x-timestamp` (Unix seconds when this attempt was signed) and `x-signature`, the hex HMAC-SHA256 of `<x-timestamp>.<raw body>` keyed with your secret key. Refuse a delivery whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes from your clock, so a captured delivery cannot be replayed. Other headers: `x-webhook-event`, `x-job-id`, `x-webhook-attempt`. Answer with any 2xx status; other answers are retried with a growing delay.

ScreenshotOptions.description: Options for one render. Exactly one of `url`, `html` or `markdown` is required. Groups: Source (What to render. Exactly one is required.) Output (File format, quality and size of the result.) Viewport (The browser window the page is rendered in.) Capture (Which part of the page ends up in the image.) Waiting (When the page counts as ready.) Customize (Change how the page looks before the capture.) Request (What the browser sends to the site.) Blocking (Remove ads, banners and other noise.) PDF (Options that apply when format is pdf.) Video (Options that apply when format is mp4, webm or gif.) Cache (Reuse a previous render instead of rendering again.) Async and webhooks (Render in the background.) Authentication (Who is making the request.)

url.description: Address of the page to capture.

html.description: HTML to render instead of a URL.

markdown.description: Markdown to render as a styled page instead of a URL.

format.description: File format of the result. mp4, webm and gif record a video of the page.

image_quality.description: Compression quality for jpeg and webp. From 1 to 100.

image_width.description: Resize the final image to this width. In CSS pixels.

image_height.description: Resize the final image to this height. In CSS pixels.

omit_background.description: Keep the page background transparent (png and webp).

response_type.description: Return the file itself, or JSON with a link to it.

viewport_width.description: Width of the browser window. In CSS pixels.

viewport_height.description: Height of the browser window. A video uses 720 unless you set it. In CSS pixels.

device_scale_factor.description: Pixel density; 2 gives a retina image.

viewport_device.description: Emulate a phone, tablet or laptop preset.

viewport_mobile.description: Render the mobile layout (honours the viewport meta tag).

full_page.description: Capture the whole page, not just the first screen.

full_page_scroll.description: Scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded images appear.

full_page_max_height.description: Cut a full-page capture off at this height. In CSS pixels.

selector.description: Capture only the first element matching this CSS selector.

clip_x.description: Left edge of the area to capture. In CSS pixels.

clip_y.description: Top edge of the area to capture. In CSS pixels.

clip_width.description: Width of the area to capture. In CSS pixels.

clip_height.description: Height of the area to capture. In CSS pixels.

wait_until.description: Page event that marks the page as loaded.

delay.description: Extra time to wait after the page has loaded. In seconds.

timeout.description: Give up if the page is not ready after this long. In seconds.

wait_for_selector.description: Wait until this element is visible before capturing.

dark_mode.description: Ask the page for its dark theme.

reduced_motion.description: Ask the page to turn animations off.

media_type.description: CSS media type to render with.

hide_selectors.description: Hide every element matching these CSS selectors.

styles.description: CSS to add to the page.

scripts.description: JavaScript to run on the page before the capture.

click.description: Click the first element matching this selector before the capture.

authorization.description: Authorization header sent to the target site only.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the page sees.

block_requests.description: Block requests whose URL matches these patterns (* is a wildcard).

pdf_fit_one_page.description: Put the whole page on a single tall PDF page.

video_duration.description: Length of the video. Left out, it follows the height of the page. In seconds.

video_max_duration.description: Longest the video may get when its length follows the page. A taller page then scrolls faster. In seconds.

video_fps.description: Frames per second. A gif takes at most 15.

video_scroll.description: Scroll from the top of the page to the bottom while recording.

video_scroll_back.description: Scroll back to the top at the end, so the video loops cleanly.

video_scroll_easing.description: How the scroll moves: a soft start and stop, or one even speed.

cache.description: Serve a stored copy when the same request was made before.

cache_ttl.description: How long a cached copy stays valid. In seconds.

cache_key.description: Change this value to force a fresh render.

async.description: Return at once and render in the background.

webhook_url.description: Address that receives the result when the render is done.

webhook_sign.description: Sign the webhook body so you can verify it came from us.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the query string, for signed links.

expires.description: Unix time in seconds after which the request is refused. Put it in a signed link to give the link a lifetime.

url.description: Link to the stored file. It carries its own expiring token and needs no access key.

cached.description: True when a stored copy was served.

expires_at.description: When the stored file is removed and its link stops working.

status.description: `done` once every job is done or failed.

WebhookEvent.description: Body POSTed to `webhook_url` when a job ends: the `Job` object plus `event`. Signed with the `x-signature` header (hex HMAC-SHA256 of `<x-timestamp>.<raw body>`, keyed with the secret key).

webhook_url.description: Receives one event per finished job.

batch_url.description: Where to read the state of every job at once.

concurrency.description: Renders that may run at the same time.

full_page_max_height.description: Tallest full-page capture on this plan, in page pixels.

full_page_max_scale.description: Largest device_scale_factor of a full-page capture on this plan.

video_max_seconds.description: Longest video (format mp4, webm, gif) on this plan, in seconds; 0 when the plan has no video capture.

error_message.description: What went wrong, in plain language.

documentation_url.description: The docs section for this error.

upgrade_url.description: Only with `quota_exceeded` and `feature_not_available`: where the account owner can move to a larger plan (billing with the next plan preselected, or the sales contact page on the top plan). Show it to the user; do not retry.

errors.description: Only with `invalid_options`: one entry per rejected option.

index.description: Bulk only: position of the request in `requests`.
